en-GB.name: 4NextBus
en-GB.summary: Live Dublin bus, LUAS, DART, and local commuter train times, with a favourite stop for each mode.
en-GB.description:
This skill tells you the next Dublin buses, Luases, DART trains, or Irish Rail commuter trains, using the National Transport Authority's real-time data.

For buses, use the number on the pole: "Alexa, ask four next bus from stop 184". Set a favourite with "Alexa, ask four next bus to set my favourite stop to 184", then "Alexa, ask four next bus".

For Luas, Dart, or local train, say the mode after the skill name: "Alexa, ask four next bus or LUAS from Dundrum southbound". You can also say "Alexa, ask four next bus to set my favourite LUAS stop to Dundrum southbound" or "Alexa, ask four next bus or LUAS to set my favourite stop to Dundrum southbound". The same two wordings work for Dart and local train. Each mode has its own favourite.

Local train means Irish Rail Commuter, not DART or InterCity. Where live information is not available, timetable times are given instead.

Note: this is not an official Dublin Bus, Luas, Irish Rail, or TFI skill. It uses publicly available real-time information provided by the National Transport Authority.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask four next bus from stop 184
Alexa, ask four next bus or LUAS from Dundrum southbound
Alexa, ask four next bus or LUAS to set my favourite stop to Dundrum southbound

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Bus: ask four next bus from stop 184; ask four next bus to set my favourite stop to 184; ask four next bus for the next bus. LUAS: ask four next bus or LUAS from Dundrum southbound; ask four next bus or LUAS to set my favourite stop to Dundrum southbound; ask four next bus to set my favourite LUAS stop to Dundrum southbound; ask four next bus or LUAS. Dart: ask four next bus or Dart from Pearse southbound. Local train: ask four next bus or local train from Maynooth westbound. History should show 4NextBus.
